evaluator.name: Codex plus deterministic validators, browser proof and Olli approval

contractChecks.evidence: Exactly six suites and fourteen scenarios cover the named repository-expression risks without adding a visual direction.
All canonical expression dependencies remain byte-identical and every inherited verifier passes.
Desktop, 320px viewport and 240px plus 400% plus RTL receiver states retain zero measured overflow.
The default state allocates one live material; reduced/static and no-WebGL retain complete identity and actions with zero canvases.
Keyboard focus restoration, polite status, retry and text-backed state meaning are present and exercised.
DEC-EXPRESSION-STRESS-CERTIFICATION-001 limits authority to repository-expression certification and preserves later consumer/provider proof.
Olli approved H-EXP-08-EXPRESSION-STRESS-PROOF and asked to proceed.

qualityDimensions.evidence: Six suites cover the highest-risk receiver, content, runtime, input, recovery and invariant seams.
Fixtures inherit canonical products, material, Wings, hierarchy, geometry, controls and motion allocation.
Zoom, reflow, RTL, keyboard, focus, targets, semantic status, reduced motion and forced-colour contracts are present.
Human approval, decision, source, schema, package, task, receipt, evaluation and roadmap state agree.
The certification explicitly excludes providers, payments, production data, consumers, navigation and the golden homepage.

notes: Expression Stress Proof 1.0.0 is canonical for its bounded repository scope.
